title: Request crash tests even when the judge says approve
narrative: A judge answers approve, but Fangore's facts show crash-location tests are missing. He runs the review and verifies product policy requests those tests (or escalates) — a model approve never alone marks the change correct. Pairs with the gap path in `fangore_jev_req_review_gap_found`.
implementation: Agentic Recipe `independent_review` provides isolated reviewer context. Agentic Recipe `decision_plane` runtime answers bounded coverage/gap questions. Host policy maps gaps and deterministic facts to `request_tests` or escalate; `mark_correct` is never emitted from judge confidence alone.
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/approve_but_missing_crash_tests.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
